questions.s:

In the second test-tube, a white precipitate was formed on addition of an equal volume of acidified aqueous barium nitrate. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate crystallised to obtain solid Q.

P: barium sulfate; Q: copper(II) nitrate
P: copper(II) sulfate; Q: barium sulfate
